title: DRAGON KEEP
oneLiner: Defend your castle walls by blasting waves of swooping dragons before they torch the keep.
mechanics: Move the castle cannon left and right along the wall.
Press A to fire bolts at flying dragons; each dragon takes several hits.
Dragons dive toward the keep and drop fireballs that damage it.
Waves grow faster and dragons become tougher over time.

controls.b: Activate a powerful fireball shot with a short cooldown

lose: The castle loses all of its keep health.
scoring: Earn points for destroying dragons, with bonus points for stopping them near the top of the screen.
